description: Stable row identifier. Duplicated when a duplicate row is injected.
Synthetic farm identifier. The same farm may appear in more than one season.
Harvest year of the synthetic season (the second year in 2016/2017).
Synthetic season label such as 2016/2017. The label does not mean the weather matched that historical year.
Study-area country. Fixed to Zimbabwe for this research scope.
Study-area province. Fixed to Mashonaland East.
Study-area location. Fixed to Macheke.
Synthetic ward placeholder (SYN-W01 to SYN-W06). Not an official ward code for Macheke.
Crop token. This research scope stores only maize.
Synthetic cultivated maize area.
Synthetic seasonal rainfall total for the maize growing season.
Synthetic average temperature over the growing season.
Synthetic mean daily maximum temperature over the growing season.
Synthetic mean daily minimum temperature over the growing season.
Synthetic topsoil pH in water.
Synthetic total soil nitrogen, percent by mass. Typical generated values are about 0.06 to 0.18.
Synthetic soil organic carbon, percent. A future SoilGrids extract in g/kg would be divided by 10 before use.
Synthetic fertilizer product applied per hectare. This is product mass, not an elemental nutrient rate.
Planting day index where 1 is 1 November. A value of 45 is 15 December. Development convention only.
Synthetic maize grain yield. This is the model target.
REAL, SYNTHETIC, or EXTERNAL. Synthetic rows must stay labelled.
Name of the file source or generator that produced the row.
Schema version used when the row was written.
